service_def.name: HealthMonitor
service_def.description: The Health Monitor service constructs a summary of the health status of the JAUS Nodes, Components, and Services. It contains a single severity field, and individual fields providing the severity code of each node.
service_def.assumptions: Messages may be delayed, lost, or reordered.

message_def.name: QueryUGVSummary
message_def.description: This query requests a ReportUGVSummary message in response, allowing a client to request a summary report of health status. The summary report is described in ReportHealthSummary.

message_def.name: UpdateUGVSummary
message_def.description: This command requests that the HealthMonitor update its health report summary. The way in which the health report summary is updated is implementation specific.

message_def.name: ReportUGVSummary
message_def.description: ReportUGVSummary provides a simple summary of the health status of the UGV to any requestor. The summary contains a list of (NodeID, severityCode) pairs, one per CM, in which the highest active severityCode is reported for each CM. This list is preceded in the message by a single severityCode for the UGV, which is the highest severity code reported by any CM in the UGV. This allows a HealthMonitor client to identify the CMs responsible for any UGV faults, and to subsequently query the HealthReporter of the responsible CM or (CMs) for full details.

fixed_field.name: severity
fixed_field.interpretation: Enumeration of severity codes, as defined below:

value_enum.interpretation: This indicates that no error condition exists.
This indicates that information is provided that does not represent an error state
An error condition is reported, but impact on operation and performance is minimal.
An error condition is reported and expected to seriously compromise use of the reporting component or device. This could also represent a potential hazard.
An error condition is reported with severity indicating component or device failure. This could also represent a significant hazard.
